{{Quote|In ancient times, on Corellia, Lord Nyax was what parents threatened their children with if they didn't eat their stewfruit or go to bed on time.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="EL2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>}}
The name of '''Lord Nyax''' was used by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] leader of the [[Cult of Lord Nyax]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The man referred to himself as [[Lord Nyax]],<ref name="SWG:LNC" /> an ancient [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Ghost (folklore)|ghost]] whose name was invoked to scare children.<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> The Nyax cultists were dangerous fanatics who worshiped Lord Nyax and sought to terrorize the citizens of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the man was leading the Followers of Nyax from the bottom level of his secret [[Lord Nyax's Cult hideout|bunker]] on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:LNC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Nyax appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LNC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lord Nyax was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
